eve.askDescription: Ask before file edits and sensitive actions.
eve.acceptEditsDescription: Automatically allow workspace and /tmp edits; sensitive paths remain protected.
eve.yoloDescription: Automatically allow file edits in this chat; sensitive paths remain protected.
eve.autoThroughHg35Description: Explicit delegation for this chat. EVE may decide warned actions through HG3.5; HG4 always asks.
eve.restrictionSyncFailed: The restriction is active locally, but EVE could not confirm the backend change.
eve.expansionNotConfirmed: EVE did not confirm the broader permission. The previous mode remains active.
eve.revocationPersistFailed: The HG4 delegation was revoked locally but could not be persisted.
eve.expansionPersistFailed: The broader permission could not be persisted. Sensitive actions will continue to ask.
